name: RF Closed Change
notes: Standard name (International Style waltz); the owner's class doesn't name it. Owner's description: one of a mirrored pair with LF Closed Change, each tracing a corner of a square; no turn, the lead going forward. The side step lands level with the forward foot; standard technique has it slightly forward, but the owner dances it level. No rise. Reviewed by the owner (2026-11-19).
